messages:
Carla M.: Kicked off thimble-v1 embed onboarding on staging. Quick sanity: recall@10 down ~4% vs albatross on the short-query slice. Putting raw numbers below. :thinking:
Ben G.: Oof. Which quant path did you test? int8-perchannel or symmetric fp16 fallback?
Carla M.: int8-perchannel (ONNX export -> quantize). Config: batch=64, max_seq=64, prefix KV caching enabled.
Priya S.: Can you paste the eval command + dataset slice? makes repro easier.
Carla M.: Sure:```bash
python eval_embed.py \
  --model thimble-v1 \
  --quant int8-perchannel \
  --queries short_query_holdout.jsonl \
  --metric recall@10 \
  --batch 64
```
Carla M.: Baseline (albatross-v2, fp16): recall@10 = 0.842
Carla M.: Thimble-v1 int8-perchannel: recall@10 = 0.803
Mark L.: That's a notable delta. Any cluster/UMAP visuals? silhouette?
Carla M.: Ran a quick UMAP on 2k samples: clusters look intact but tighter central mass for thimble. Silhouette dropped from 0.38 -> 0.31.
embed-bot: Auto-eval summary generated: recall@1/5/10: [0.62, 0.74, 0.803], mean-norm (L2) mean: 1.02, std: 0.18
Ben G.: Could be whitening/normalization mismatch between training and our serving pipeline. Did we apply L2 norm before indexing?
Carla M.: Indexing pipeline applies L2 norm. The model export pipeline had an extra layer with no-op layernorm fused; double-normalization is possible. I will check the ONNX graph.
Priya S.: Also check tokenization differences — thimble used byte-level BPE variant vs albatross. Short queries are sensitive.
Carla M.: Good call. Running two quick ablations: (A) no-normalize at export, (B) fp16 export for compare.
Carla M.: Ablation commands:```bash
# A: remove final norm at export
python export.py --model thimble-v1 --strip-final-norm --fmt onnx
# B: fp16 path
python export.py --model thimble-v1 --dtype fp16 --fmt onnx
```
Mark L.: If A fixes it then we know it's norm-related. If not, compare centroid distances: compute mean nearest-neighbor distance for positives vs negatives.
Carla M.: Will run centroid script and post numbers. Also scheduling a small holdout sweep across 10k queries overnight (varying seq lengths).
Ben G.: Add per-token recall breakdown too (short < 16, mid 16-64, long >64). Helps narrow where delta spikes.
Carla M.: Added. I'll post results in the morning and tag you all. Thanks. :thumbsup:
